entities.summary: The grizzled squirrel wildlife sanctuary (gsws), also known as srivilliputhur wildlife sanctuary, was established in 1988 to protect the vulnerable grizzled giant squirrel (ratufa macroura) in india. Grizzled Squirrel Wildlife Sanctuary is a protected area with roots in Asia.
